meaning:
1) something that restrains, halter, jaw
1a) halter
1a1) of restraint thrown off (fig)
1b) jaw (of crocodile)

renderings.kjv: and there shall be a bridle

elsewhere.note: For he has untied his cord, and afflicted me; and they have thrown off restraint before me.
Don’t be like the horse, or like the mule, which have no understanding, who are controlled by bit and bridle, or else they will not come near to you.
